name: ballerinax/confluent.cregistry
description: [Confluent Schema Registry](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/schema-registry/) serves as a centralized repository for managing Avro schemas, ensuring data consistency and compatibility in serialization and deserialization processes.

typeDefs.name: ErrorDetails
typeDefs.description: The error details type for the Ballerina Confluent Schema Registry module.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The HTTP status code for the error

fields.name: errorCode
fields.description: The error code for the error

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: Represents any error related to Ballerina Confluent Schema Registry module.

typeDefs.name: ConnectionConfig
typeDefs.description: Provides a set of configurations to control the behaviours when communicating with a schema registry.

fields.name: baseUrl
fields.description: The base URL of the schema registry endpoint

fields.name: identityMapCapacity
fields.description: Capacity of the schema ID map for a particular subject

fields.name: originals
fields.description: Connection configurations required to integrate with the schema registry

fields.name: headers
fields.description: Custom headers to be included in the requests

clients.name: Client
clients.description: Consists of APIs to integrate with Avro Schema Registry.

parameters.name: baseUrl
parameters.description: The base URL of the schema registry endpoint

parameters.name: identityMapCapacity
parameters.description: Capacity of the schema ID map for a particular subject

parameters.name: originals
parameters.description: Connection configurations required to integrate with the schema registry

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Custom headers to be included in the requests

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: The configurations to be used when initializing the `connector`

functions.name: register
functions.description: Registers a schema with the schema registry.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: The subject under which the schema should be registered

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: The Avro schema to be registered

return.description: The ID of the registered schema, or an `cregistry:Error` if registration fails

functions.name: getSchemaById
functions.description: Retrieves a schema from the schema registry by its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the schema to retrieve

return.description: The retrieved schema or an `cregistry:Error` if the schema does not exist
